title: Subfield generated by one element
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a field, $F\subset\Omega$ a subfield, and $\alpha\in\Omega$. The field $F(\alpha)$ is the smallest subfield of $\Omega$ containing $F$ and $\alpha$: the intersection of all subfields of $\Omega$ containing $F\cup\{\alpha\}$, which is a subfield of $\Omega$ containing $F$ and $\alpha$ and contained in every such subfield. In this chapter $F=\mathbf Q$, the prime field of a field $\Omega$ of characteristic $0$, and $\mathbf Q(\alpha)$ is the smallest subfield of $\Omega$ containing $\alpha$.
